metric.purpose: Large financial figures and dashboard totals; tabular numerals.

body.purpose: Default reading text and dialog bodies.

label.purpose: Buttons, nav items, form labels, toolbar text.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default committed action; Ledger Blue fill, compact desktop height.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 12px; background: #1E5F8C; color: #fff; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 90ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1A5379; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1E5F8C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Lower-priority action; text-only in Ink Muted.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 12px; background: transparent; color: #64748B; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 90ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #FAFBFD; color: #0F172A; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1E5F8C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Compact outlined field; border shifts to Ledger Blue on focus, no glow.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background: #fff; color: #0F172A; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid #E3E8EF; border-radius: 3px; transition: border-color 90ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #94A3B8; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #CBD5E1; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #1E5F8C; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Reusable flat surface; hairline border, lifts on hover.
components.html:
الملخص المالي
إجمالي المدفوعات هذا الشهر
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #E3E8EF; border-radius: 7px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(15,23,42,0.03); padding: 16px; transition: box-shadow 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-panel:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 8px -2px rgba(15,23,42,0.12); border-color: #CBD5E1; } .ds-panel-title { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.005em; color: #0F172A; } .ds-panel-body { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #64748B; }

components.name: Nav Item (Active)
components.description: Sidebar item in its active state; soft-blue fill with a 3px inline-start accent rail.
components.html: المشاريع
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 28px; margin: 1px 5px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 3px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #0F172A; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 90ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-item:hover:not(.ds-nav-item--active) { background: #FAFBFD; } .ds-nav-item--active { background: #EAF2F9; color: #1E5F8C; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item--active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset-block: 4px; inset-inline-start: 0; width: 3px; border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0; background: #1E5F8C; } .ds-nav-ico { flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Status Orb
components.description: Connection/health dot with an optional pulsing ring for live service/tunnel state.
components.css: .ds-orb { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #94A3B8; } .ds-orb--success { background: #16A34A; } .ds-orb--warning { background: #F59E0B; } .ds-orb--error { background: #DC2626; } .ds-orb--pulse::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -4px; border-radius: 999px; background: inherit; opacity: 0.35; animation: ds-pulse 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0% { transform: scale(0.6); opacity: 0.5; } 100% { transform: scale(1.6); opacity: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-orb--pulse::after { animation: none; } }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Small state chip backed by a soft semantic tint.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 3px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; background: #EEF2F7; color: #64748B; } .ds-chip--success { background: #E7F6EC; color: #16A34A; } .ds-chip--warning { background: #FEF3E1; color: #B36106; } .ds-chip--error { background: #FDECEC; color: #DC2626; }

narrative.overview: Contractor Plus is a precise desktop instrument for tracking money and work, not a web app that happens to run on a desktop. Its surface is built like a well-kept ledger: dense, tabular, hairline-ruled, with quiet chrome so the data is always the hero. It serves both a non-technical contractor owner and keyboard-bound office staff, so it must read calm and unintimidating at a glance while staying tight and fast under the fingers. The language is native-desktop business software rendered through Electron but never looking like a browser: structure from 1px hairline borders and tonal layering, low crisp corners, opaque flat toolbars, a thin bottom status strip, one UI type family, and tabular numerals. It rejects both sterile enterprise gray and consumer web-app fluff, and is Arabic-first and RTL by default.
keyCharacteristics: Native-desktop density: hairline borders, low radii, opaque flat toolbars, a bottom status bar.
One quiet UI type family, tuned tight, with tabular numerals for money and metrics.
Calm blue chrome; a rare burnt-amber accent that only marks what needs attention.
Flat by default; shadows appear only on genuinely floating layers (menus, dialogs).

rules.name: The Ochre Flag Rule
rules.body: The amber accent (#D97706) is never decoration. It appears only to flag the one thing on a screen that needs attention. If two things are amber, one is wrong.

rules.name: The Blue-Is-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Ledger Blue owns navigation, primary actions, selection, and focus, never body backgrounds or large fills. Chrome is calm; the data carries the screen.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: No display font, no second family. Hierarchy comes from size and weight within Segoe UI.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every money value, metric, count, and clock uses tabular-nums so columns align and figures don't jitter as they update.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px borders (#E3E8EF), not shadows. If a boundary needs emphasis, step the border to Border Strong (#CBD5E1); do not add a shadow to a non-floating element.

dos: Do define structure with 1px hairline borders (#E3E8EF) and tonal layering; reserve shadows for floating layers only.
Do keep the amber accent (#D97706) rare, one attention flag per screen.
Do use tabular-nums on every money value, metric, count, and clock.
Do use one UI family (Segoe UI stack); build hierarchy with size/weight, not new fonts.
Do keep radii low and crisp (3-7px), density compact, and forms Enter-to-save and fully keyboard-operable with a visible Ledger Blue focus ring.
Do author in logical properties (inline-start/end) so Arabic RTL is correct by default; verify AA contrast in both themes.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion; keep transitions 90-220ms and state-conveying only.
donts: Don't ship sterile enterprise gray, gray-on-gray with no hierarchy, no accent, and dead screens (SAP/legacy-ERP look).
Don't ship consumer web-app fluff: no big rounded cards, roomy padding, decorative gradients, marketing hero sections, or illustrated flourishes.
Don't use toy/gamified touches (mascots, confetti, candy color) or the dark-glass AI-product aesthetic (glassmorphism, neon gradients, purple-black).

Don't use background-clip: text gradient text, or a border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe on cards, callouts, or alerts (the sidebar's 3px active rail is the one sanctioned exception).
Don't add glass/blur to the top bar or any non-floating chrome; desktop toolbars are opaque and flat.
Don't reach for a modal first, invent non-standard controls, or let a save button look different in two places.
